notes.title: The Machines Arena is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
TMA is back on Steam with numerous updates and features that Steam players have never had the chance to test before. While veterans from other platforms will feel right at home, those who previously played only on Steam are in for a significantly expanded and enriched game.

Here’s what’s new for Steam players:

[h2]New Features & Modes[/h2]

[u][b]PVE game mode[/b][/u]: Death Run is a high-stakes, high-adrenaline PvE mode. It’s all about mastering your skills and knowing when to quit while you’re ahead. Race against the clock, defeat death, and aim for glory!

[u][b]New Maps[/b][/u]: Explore brand-new battlegrounds that will challenge your tactics and keep you on your toes.

[u][b]Crossplay Compatibility[/b][/u]: TMA is now fully crossplay-enabled! Team up or fight with friends on any platform or device.

[u][b]Collectible Skins & Familiars[/b][/u]: Customize your heroes with unique Skins and powerful Familiars. Flaunt your style in the arena and make a statement with every move.

[u][b]Quality-of-life improvements[/b][/u]: Enjoy a smoother, more polished experience with updated graphics, a fresh UI, balance improvements, and much more.


Download The Machines Arena on Steam today and cement your legacy in the arena, and don't forget to join our Discord community!


[url=https://discord.gg/themachinesarena][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40854082/1fc562eec157338dfc7cacad386018eff3c25809.png[/img][/url]
